quick: 50 mg daily x5 days from cycle day 5
May reduce milk; avoid if breastfeeding
summary: Clomiphene citrate is a SERM used to induce ovulation in anovulatory women desiring pregnancy, including PCOS and certain amenorrhea syndromes. Treatment starts at 50 mg daily for 5 days from about cycle day 5, increasing to 100 mg if needed, for up to about 6 cycles. Key risks are multiple gestation, ovarian hyperstimulation, ovarian enlargement and reversible visual disturbances. Contraindicated in pregnancy and liver disease.
indications: Ovulatory dysfunction in women desiring pregnancy after exclusion/treatment of other infertility causes
Amenorrhea-galactorrhea syndrome, psychogenic amenorrhea, post-contraceptive amenorrhea and selected secondary amenorrhea

dosage.d: 50 mg once daily for 5 days, starting about cycle day 5
dosage.n: Start anytime if no recent bleeding
Begin as early as 30 days after previous course
Do not exceed ~6 total cycles (incl. 3 ovulatory)

admin: Take orally for 5 days as scheduled, with or without food
Time intercourse to coincide with expected ovulation (5-10 days after the course)
Exclude pregnancy, ovarian enlargement and cysts before each new course
Use the lowest effective dose to reduce multiple-pregnancy risk
Stop and evaluate if visual symptoms or ovarian enlargement occur
moa: Clomiphene is a nonsteroidal SERM that binds hypothalamic and pituitary estrogen receptors, reducing negative feedback from circulating estrogen. This increases pulsatile GnRH and pituitary release of FSH and LH, stimulating follicular growth and triggering the ovulatory LH surge.

absolute: Liver disease or history of hepatic dysfunction
Abnormal uterine bleeding of undetermined origin
Ovarian cysts or enlargement not due to PCOS
relative: History of visual disturbance on prior therapy
monitor: Ovarian size (pelvic exam) before each course

preg: Contraindicated - offers no benefit in pregnancy and animal studies showed embryo-fetal loss and malformations. Exclude pregnancy before each course; counsel about potential fetal risk if conception occurred during a treatment cycle.
lact: May reduce lactation in some women. Avoid use during breastfeeding unless clearly necessary.
renal: No specific dose adjustment described; use general caution.
hepatic: Contraindicated in patients with liver disease or a history of hepatic dysfunction.

moderate: Other gonadotropins (hMG/hCG) - additive ovarian stimulation and hyperstimulation risk
Ospemifene and other SERMs - potential additive/antagonistic estrogenic effects
minor: No clinically significant routine drug interactions established
interactions.alcohol: Limit alcohol while undergoing fertility treatment.
interactions.diagnostics: May alter thyroid-binding globulin and other estrogen-sensitive lab tests.

emergency: Severe ovarian hyperstimulation (abdominal distension, ascites, dyspnea)

monitoring: Pelvic examination before each course to exclude ovarian enlargement/cysts
Documentation of ovulation (basal body temperature, mid-luteal progesterone, ultrasound)
Visual symptoms - discontinue if they occur
Pregnancy test before repeating a course
counsel: Take for 5 days as directed and time intercourse around expected ovulation
Report blurred vision, spots or flashes - stop and contact your doctor
Seek care for severe abdominal/pelvic pain, bloating or shortness of breath
Be aware of the increased chance of twins/multiple pregnancy
Do not exceed the prescribed number of cycles
pk: Ovulation usually 5-10 days after a course
Store at 20-25 C (68-77 F), protect from light/heat
pearls: First-line oral agent for ovulation induction, including in PCOS
Limit to about 6 cycles - prolonged use is not recommended and may raise ovarian risk
Counsel on multiple-pregnancy and ovarian hyperstimulation risk
Stop permanently if visual disturbances occur
Use the lowest effective dose and exclude pregnancy/ovarian cysts before each course
missed: If a dose during the 5-day course is missed, take it as soon as remembered; if it is nearly time for the next dose, contact the prescriber for advice rather than doubling up, as accurate timing affects the cycle.
overdose: Overdose may intensify side effects such as nausea, vomiting, hot flushes, visual disturbances and ovarian enlargement/hyperstimulation. There is no specific antidote; provide supportive care and monitor for ovarian hyperstimulation.
